title: Forge Platform installer composition catalog trust
description: Public, code-signed trust policy for the separately signed composition catalog. It binds a distinct Ed25519 key threshold to exactly one installer release-trust configuration; it contains no locator, transport, credential, private key, product runtime authority, or install action.
$comment: maxSerializedUtf8Bytes=32768; maxJsonNestingDepth=64; maxJsonNodes=16384. JSON Schema validates values, while the strict runtime parser enforces byte/node bounds, canonical Base64, key ordering/uniqueness, threshold cardinality, and configuration_sha256 recomputation.

ed25519_public_keys.description: The producer serializes keys in strictly ascending key_id order with unique key IDs and public-key material; strict runtime parsers enforce those semantic constraints before recomputing configuration_sha256.

public_key_base64.description: Canonical standard Base64 encoding of exactly 32 raw Ed25519 public-key bytes; strict runtime parsers verify decoded length and canonical re-encoding.
